sentences.text: Silesaurus measured approximately 2.3 meters in length.
The animal was lightly built and likely lived an active, fast lifestyle.
Evidence suggests the tip of its lower jaw was covered by a keratinous beak.
It is often considered a quadruped that walked on all four legs thanks to its long, gracile forelimbs.
Fossil dung containing beetles was attributed to Silesaurus, suggesting it was not strictly a plant-eater.
The type species Silesaurus opolensis was described by Jerzy Dzik in 2003.
Fossils were found in the Keuper Clay near Opole in Silesia, Poland, which is the origin of the species name.
There are three recorded fossil occurrences of the animal.
In 2020, researchers concluded that Silesaurus was likely an obligate quadruped based on its short hindlimbs and elongated forelimbs.
Most scientists believe Silesaurus was not a dinosaur but rather a dinosauriform.
Silesaurus possesses some dinosaurian traits, such as a short iliac projection.
The animal belongs to the family Silesauridae.
Silesaurus lived during the Carnian stage, between 233.6 and 227.3 million years ago.
Researchers initially debated whether Silesaurus was an early ornithischian, a basal sauropodomorph, or a non-dinosaur relative with similar adaptations.
There is an ongoing debate over whether Silesaurus was capable of bipedalism in some circumstances.
According to alternative theories, Silesaurus occupies a position near the base of ornithischian dinosaurs.
It is debated whether Silesaurus is a dinosaur or a dinosauriform, despite possessing features like a short iliac projection used for tail muscle attachment.
